messages:
Priya: Heads-up team: Customer 'Vanguard Health' asked to accelerate their private pilot to next week. Requirements: customer-managed keys (HSM) preferred, hard p95 <= 300ms, and a staged A/B canary across two regions. Need a quick cross-team gating plan today.
Dan: Runtime q: model size and expected seq len? That determines batching and kv cache feasibility.
Priya: They plan to serve a 13B model, avg 180 tokens, peak 85 QPS per region, ~40 sustained. They said 7B is acceptable if needed but worried about quality.
Tae: Infra: two-region dedicated pools + VPC peering + HSM path per region. HSM onboarding + attestation across regions is the slow path (~10 biz days). We can stand up hosted-KMS pools in both regions in ~3 days.
Maya: Security: HSM multi-region attestation is heavy. If they insist on HSM for pilot, we need signed attestation + legal OK. Alternative: hosted-KMS with customer-approved audit forwarding and ephemeral key wrapping. I'll prepare a risk blurb.
Jordan: SRE: p95 <= 300ms is doable if we enforce continuous batching + prefix cache and keep warm nodes. For 13B we'd need pinned slots and a prewarm policy (idle-prewarm + burst slots). Without HSM, hosted-KMS route should not affect latency.
Lena: CS: Vanguard prefers HSM but timeline is flexible if we give explicit cutover milestones. They also want a rollback SLA in case latency/regressions hit during canary.
Priya: Proposal (fastest): do hosted-KMS for pilot + 13B but with strict rollback gates; fallback to 7B if p95 > 320ms in canary. Parallel path: start HSM onboarding (in case they want cutover later).
Dan: Runtime plan: implement routing policy + canary guard: prefer pool-hsm if tag set, else pool-hosted-kms. Canary policy: 10% traffic for 15m in region A, measure p95, error-rate, and token-cost delta. Rollback triggers: p95 > 320ms OR error-rate increase > 2x OR token-cost > projected by 25%. Pseudocode: ```
route_policy:
  - condition: request.customer.hsm == true and pool.hsm_ready == true
    target: pool-hsm
  - else:
    target: pool-hosted-kms
canary:
  regionA: {traffic_pct: 10, duration: 15m}
  regionB: {traffic_pct: 30, duration: 60m}
rollback_triggers:
  - metric: latency.p95
    threshold_ms: 320
    window: 5m
  - metric: errors.rate
    multiplier: 2.0
    window: 5m
```
Tae: I can provision hosted-KMS pools in both regions in 72h once we lock model/slot counts. HSM pool timeline remains 10 biz days. I'll also add autoscale headroom for burst handling.
Maya: I'll draft a customer-facing risk/controls blurb that covers hosted-KMS fallback, audit-forwarding, and a timeline for cutover to HSM. Also list required approvals if Vanguard insists on HSM now.
Jordan: I'll own the canary dashboard and the automated rollback hook. Need runtime to emit latency p95 and error-rate to the canary pipeline. Dan can you add those hooks?
Dan: Yep. Will add telemetry emitters + canary guard config (PR in 48h). Also will run a quick perf run with 13B pinned vs 7B to confirm expected p95 at target QPS.
Priya: Action items: 
- Maya: customer-facing risk blurb + HSM onboarding checklist (EOD).
- Tae: GPU slot calc + hosted-KMS pool ETA for 13B and 7B (tomorrow).
- Dan: routing policy + canary guard PR + perf numbers (48h).
- Jordan: canary dashboard + rollback hook (48h).
- Lena: update SOW with fallback plan, acceptance criteria, and explicit rollback SLA (today).
- Priya: coordinate customer communication and sign-off matrix.

oncall-bot: Created ticket RDW-9001 "Vanguard Health pilot: HSM/onramp gating + staged canary" and scheduled sync 1820001600 (2pm PT). Assigned: Maya, Tae, Dan, Jordan, Lena, Priya.
Priya: If HSM slips we default to hosted-KMS + 13B with canary + rollback to 7B if needed. We'll surface tradeoffs to Vanguard and get a written sign-off on the fallback plan. Please review the SOW doc before the sync: https://docs.redwood.ai/onramps/vanguard (pinged). :white_check_mark:
